section: Tall unit top elements H. 48 | without fixings
source_pages: printed p.171 / PDF 173 (taken WHOLE - three positions)
family_naming_note: Joins the name catalog_map already used. Prefix SC, read from the row.
extraction_note: printed p.171 taken WHOLE 2026-10-04 - 2026-10-04, group 1 of the catalog recon (Andriy: generate what can be generated with confidence). The H.48 twin of printed p.172 position for position: top-hung W.45-120, side-hinged single door W.45 and W.60 only, two doors W.90 and W.120. 3 positions, 9 codes, d.62; codes and widths checked by script against the text layer, the page checked on a 90-dpi render.
side_hinged_width_note: THE SIDE-HINGED SINGLE DOOR STOPS AT W.60 here too: SC0531 and SC0631 and nothing wider; above that the side-hinged option is the two-door position, W.90 and W.120 - the same rule printed p.172 states.

data.plinth_note: ZERO, AND IT HAS TO BE STATED. Generator.plinth_h_mm defaults to Standards::PLINTH_H_MM when a family is silent. A top element stands on the tall unit below it, so silence would draw it a 100 mm plinth in mid-air. Learned on tall_top_h36/h72 the same day.
data.mounting_note: NO `mounting` VALUE, AND THE ABSENCE IS A READING. 'without fixings': this element rests on the tall unit beneath it and meets neither the floor nor the wall, which are the only two values Object Contract v2.1 allows. See tall_top_h72.json for the full argument.
data.depth_note: d.62 only - one label serves all three code tables and no second band is printed.
data.source_ref: CESAR - 2 Kitchen System.pdf printed p.171 / PDF 173
data.n_elle_note: printed p.171 carries 'N Elle' and 50,2 in its TEXT LAYER and prints neither. NOT PRINTED, verified the way printed p.172's was: a 300-dpi crop at the coordinates pdftotext gives shows blank paper beside the 48 elevation (2026-10-04). IN THE FILE, NOT IN THE BOOK. DOCUMENT LEAD BELOW SOURCE TRUST: used for nothing, drawn by nothing, never quoted to Elda as something the catalog prints.

top_element_top_hung.description: Top element with top-hung door - 1 top-hung door - 1 shelf

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front, hinged along its top edge. Single elevation, 48 - no handle/gola pair is printed, as at H.36 and H.72.

top_element_top_hung.wall_hung_note: REFUSED IN THE CATALOG'S OWN WORDS, in the section title on printed p.171: 'without fixings'. Not a missing glyph and not a derivation - the same kind of reading printed p.37 gives with 'not available wall hung'.
top_element_top_hung.notes: Five widths, W.45-120, the twin of printed p.172 position 1.
top_element_top_hung.stands_on_note: 2026-09-28, core 1.9.6 (Andriy, 7612): a top element rests on the tall unit beneath it - printed p.170-173, 'without fixings' - so its bottom is that unit's top, read off the SELECTED unit through its code and its own ground (a one-door tall on the run's 60 plinth tops out at 2280). Before this it was drawn on the floor and placed by hand or by probe. Nothing selected: refused, as Horizontal Thin is.
